audit.process: shopfront — adding a component and automated translation
audit.scope: fixtures/repos/node-front/repo (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .claude/skills, scripts, tools, .github/workflows, eslint/stylelint/husky/vitest, package.json)

elements.finding: An agent translates with Edit and Bash(git *) with no path restriction, then gh pr merge --auto merges the bot's first PR into main with no human review, no dry_run and no protected environment, while the only relevant CI (key parity) passes by construction.
elements.target: L4 prepares (JSON report, short-circuit if empty, dry_run input), L1 translates and opens a draft PR with Edit(src/locales/en.json) only, the merge goes back through a human; no more auto-merge.
elements.check: A dry_run=true run produces the missing.json artifact and no PR; a real run produces a draft PR that cannot be merged without approval; no occurrence of 'pr merge --auto'.

elements.finding: Two of the three "Enforced by" are false (check-i18n does not read the templates, no-raw-color does not visit the template), five mandatory rules have no guardrail (story+test, coverage, tokens.css, eslint-disable, src/payment PCI), and the story rule contradicts itself between l.20 and l.33.
elements.target: Each mandatory rule points to a real L3/L4 guardrail (eslint vue-i18n/no-raw-text, check-components, coverage thresholds, CODEOWNERS), 'Enforced by' is only written when it is true, l.31-37 replaced by the pointer to the skill, l.23-24 removed, l.3 mentions the autonomous workflow.
elements.check: For each 'Enforced by', a deliberate red test (hard-coded text in a template, component without a story, hex in :style) makes ci.yml fail; a single wording of the story rule in the repository.

elements.finding: Three of the four rules contradict AGENTS.md and the linter: Options API tolerated under 50 lines (eslint refuses it everywhere), hex tolerated with a TODO, story optional.
elements.target: File reduced to a pointer to AGENTS.md or generated from it, with no rule of its own.
elements.check: No rule of vue.mdc contradicts an active eslint/stylelint rule or AGENTS.md.

elements.finding: Four instructions contradict AGENTS.md (Options API, hex in overrides, story optional, hard-coded strings accepted in admin) and the command 'npm test' does not exist in package.json.
elements.target: Pointer to AGENTS.md or generated content; commands taken from the table AGENTS.md:9-14.
elements.check: Every command cited exists in package.json; no exception to a rule of AGENTS.md.

elements.finding: Step 6 has the coverage percentage compared by eye with main (unstructured return, not reproducible), l.9 imposes the story 'even with no UI' while AGENTS.md:33 exempts it, and steps 1-5 duplicate AGENTS.md:32-36.
elements.target: Step 6 becomes 'run npm run test:unit' once coverage.thresholds is in place; story rule settled and enforced by check-components; AGENTS.md keeps only the pointer.
elements.check: The skill no longer contains a manual check of a number; npm run test:unit fails when coverage goes under the threshold.

elements.finding: Duplicates word for word flatten and the reading of the locales of check-i18n.mjs, with no test, in one direction only (fr→en) and with no short exit when the list is empty.
elements.target: A single command (check-i18n.mjs --json or scripts/i18n.mjs check|report) with a vitest test; the workflow calls the subcommand.
elements.check: A single flatten in scripts/; agent-fix-i18n.yml no longer calls i18n-report.mjs.

elements.finding: The bare Literal visitor is only called on the <script>: the literals of the <template> (:style, style="") are not seen despite the header that promises 'templates and inline styles'; no RuleTester; false positives on anchors such as '#add'.
elements.target: Rule rewritten with defineTemplateBodyVisitor (VLiteral/Literal/TemplateElement of the template) on top of the script, regex anchored on a CSS value, RuleTester tests.
elements.check: A component with <span style="color:#fff"> makes npm run lint fail; router.push('#add') does not; the rule's tests run in test:unit.

elements.finding: color-no-hex covers src/styles/tokens.css, the only legitimate place for hex values, so the rule and its exception share the same scope; stylelint-config-standard and postcss-html (for the .vue files) are not declared: the guard '<style> without hex' does not run as is.
elements.target: ignoreFiles for tokens.css, postcss-html overrides for *.vue, dependencies declared.
elements.check: npm run lint:style passes on the repository as is, fails on a .vue with color:#fff in <style>, reports nothing in tokens.css.

elements.finding: Dead script (no caller, 'no longer called' at l.1), cannot run in ESM (require with type: module) and destructive with no dry-run.
Hook never installed: husky absent from the devDependencies and no prepare script; a fictitious guard.
elements.target: Wire it (husky + prepare, add lint:style and check:i18n) or delete it.
elements.check: After npm ci, a commit with a hard-coded hex is refused locally; or .husky/ no longer exists.

elements.finding: A single include @AGENTS.md: single source, no duplication.
elements.target: Unchanged; a model for vue.mdc and copilot-instructions.md.
elements.check: The file stays a lone include.

elements.finding: Checks the parity of the fr/en keys with exit 1 and a typed message, called by the CLI and the CI; its only flaw: the excessive promise made about it in AGENTS.md:18.
elements.target: Unchanged; takes in the --json mode that comes from the merge with i18n-report.
elements.check: A vitest test covers the parity on two fixtures.

elements.finding: Carries two real guardrails (no-raw-color, component-api-style script-setup) on src/**; this is where vue-i18n/no-raw-text lands.
elements.target: Unchanged in its structure; the vue-i18n and eslint-comments rules are added.
elements.check: npm run lint stays the single command of the lint job.

elements.finding: The repository's CLI is correctly exposed and consistent with the table AGENTS.md:9-14; the missing dependencies that keep some scripts from running are listed in unverified.
elements.target: Unchanged; check:components and the missing devDependencies are added.
elements.check: Each script cited by an instruction file exists.

elements.finding: Right layer; will receive coverage.thresholds and the json-summary reporter to carry the rule 'coverage does not go down'.
elements.target: coverage.thresholds (+ autoUpdate) and json-summary are added.
elements.check: npm run test:unit fails when AppButton.spec.ts is deleted.

elements.finding: Five independent jobs, one per line of the AGENTS.md table; will receive the component completeness job and the coverage guard.
elements.target: A components job (check-components) is added; coverage is carried by vitest.
elements.check: A component without a story or without a spec turns the CI red.

elements.finding: A healthy L4 model: protected environment, secret held in L4, --json output read back by jq rather than a log.
elements.check: The PR comment contains the URL that comes from deploy.json.

process_leaks.rule: Every visible string goes through t(), never hard-coded text in a template
process_leaks.if_skipped: Untranslated text shipped to production (incident #198); NewBadge.vue:6 ships a hard-coded "New" and passes the whole CI, because check-i18n.mjs only reads the JSON files (scripts/check-i18n.mjs:2)
process_leaks.guard_tool: @intlify/eslint-plugin-vue-i18n rules vue-i18n/no-raw-text and vue-i18n/no-missing-keys in eslint.config.js (lint job of ci.yml)

process_leaks.rule: A component has a Storybook story
process_leaks.if_skipped: Component never reviewed visually; NewBadge.vue has no story and the CI is green; four contradictory wordings (AGENTS.md:33, SKILL.md:9, vue.mdc:7, copilot-instructions.md:5)
process_leaks.guard_tool: scripts/check-components.mjs (glob src/components/*.vue → requires .stories.ts, exit 1) wired into ci.yml

process_leaks.rule: A component has a unit test
process_leaks.if_skipped: Untested component; NewBadge.vue has no spec and the CI is green

process_leaks.rule: Unit coverage does not go down
process_leaks.if_skipped: Silent loss of tests (incident #240); the only check is by eye in SKILL.md:13, vitest.config.ts:3 has no thresholds
process_leaks.guard_tool: coverage.thresholds (+ autoUpdate) and json-summary reporter in vitest.config.ts, or coverage diff vs main as a PR gate

process_leaks.if_skipped: Change to a PCI module with no owner review; the agent of agent-fix-i18n.yml:19 has unrestricted Edit and auto-merge
process_leaks.guard_tool: .github/CODEOWNERS + review required by branch protection; Edit(src/locales/en.json) in the workflow

process_leaks.rule: Never change src/styles/tokens.css without a design ticket
process_leaks.if_skipped: Theme drift with no design validation
process_leaks.guard_tool: .github/CODEOWNERS (design team) + PR template with a ticket field

process_leaks.rule: No hard-coded color in the template (style attribute, :style)
process_leaks.if_skipped: Hex forgotten in a template → broken dark theme (incident #212); no-raw-color only visits the <script> (tools/eslint-plugin-design-tokens/index.js:11)
process_leaks.guard_tool: no-raw-color rule rewritten with defineTemplateBodyVisitor + RuleTester; stylelint with customSyntax postcss-html

process_leaks.rule: No eslint-disable without a dated justification
A person reviews every diff before merge
process_leaks.if_skipped: Hallucinated translations merged into main with no review (agent-fix-i18n.yml:21-23)
process_leaks.guard_tool: Removal of the auto-merge, protected environment with required reviewers, branch protection

guarded_rules.rule: Parity of the fr/en keys in the locales
No hard-coded color in the <script> and the .css files (partial guard)
Table "if you touch X, run Y, enforced in CI by ci.yml job Z"

remediation.action: Remove the auto-merge, restrict allowedTools to Edit(src/locales/en.json) and gh pr create, add inputs.dry_run, short-circuit if missing.json is empty, open the PR as a draft and target it by the URL of gh pr create.
remediation.check: dry_run=true run: artifact and no PR; real run: draft PR that cannot be merged without review; no occurrence of 'pr merge --auto'.

remediation.action: Add @intlify/eslint-plugin-vue-i18n (no-raw-text, no-missing-keys) in eslint.config.js and fix NewBadge.vue:6.
remediation.check: npm run lint fails on NewBadge.vue before the fix and passes after; the lint job is red on a template with hard-coded text.

remediation.action: Create .github/CODEOWNERS for src/payment/ and src/styles/tokens.css, turn on the review required by branch protection, add a PR template with a design ticket field.
remediation.check: A PR touching src/payment/ requires the owner's approval; the agent workflow cannot write there.

remediation.action: Rewrite no-raw-color with defineTemplateBodyVisitor, anchored regex, add RuleTester tests.
remediation.check: Red test on style="color:#fff" in a template; green on '#add'.

remediation.action: Declare stylelint-config-standard and postcss-html, overrides for *.vue, ignoreFiles src/styles/tokens.css.
remediation.check: npm run lint:style green on the repository, red on a <style> with hex, silent on tokens.css.

remediation.action: Settle the story rule (recommended: mandatory), create scripts/check-components.mjs requiring .stories.ts and .spec.ts per component, components job in ci.yml, complete NewBadge.
remediation.check: CI red on the repository as is, green after the two files of NewBadge are added.

remediation.action: Add coverage.thresholds (+ autoUpdate) and the json-summary reporter in vitest.config.ts.
remediation.check: npm run test:unit fails when AppButton.spec.ts is deleted.

remediation.action: Merge into check-i18n.mjs (--json) or scripts/i18n.mjs check|report with a vitest test, update the workflow.
remediation.check: A single flatten in scripts/; the workflow calls the subcommand.

remediation.action: Remove the manual coverage check (l.13), align l.9 with the settled story rule, reference check:components.
remediation.check: The skill no longer asks to open coverage/index.html.

remediation.action: Replace with a pointer to AGENTS.md or content generated from it.
remediation.check: No rule of its own; zero contradiction with eslint/stylelint.

remediation.action: Replace with a pointer to AGENTS.md; replace npm test with the commands of AGENTS.md:9-14.
remediation.check: Every command cited exists in package.json.

remediation.action: Rewrite the 'Enforced by' (l.17-18) according to the real guardrails, add those of l.20-21 and 27-29, replace l.31-37 with the pointer to the skill, remove l.23-24, mention the autonomous workflow at l.3.
remediation.check: Each 'Enforced by' has a reproducible red test; a single wording of the story rule in the repository.
An eslint-disable without a description makes npm run lint fail.

remediation.action: Wire husky (devDependency + prepare, add lint:style and check:i18n) or delete .husky/.
remediation.check: Local commit refused on a hard-coded hex, or folder absent.

unverified: No script run (no node_modules, repository not to be modified): the behaviour of stylelint on the .vue files and tokens.css is deduced from .stylelintrc.json:1, package.json:9,17-28 and the stylelint 16 documentation, not observed.

Dependencies absent from package.json:17-28 but imported or assumed: stylelint-config-standard, postcss-html, @testing-library/vue (AppButton.spec.ts:1), jsdom (vitest.config.ts:3), @playwright/test (tests/e2e/cart.spec.ts:1), husky, @storybook/vue3-vite; if that is the real state, the lint, unit and e2e jobs of ci.yml cannot be green.
src/payment/ does not exist in the repository: the forbidden item AGENTS.md:29 is audited as a rule, not against code.

Settings of the remote repository not readable: branch protection, required reviewers, rules of the preview environment (deploy-preview.yml:7), configuration of app/acme-bot, secrets BOT_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN.
Issues #212, #198, #240 and PR #231 cited in AGENTS.md cannot be consulted (synthetic repository, README.md:3).
Behaviour of gh pr list --author app/acme-bot … .[0] (agent-fix-i18n.yml:22) with no open PR: assumed to fail on an empty argument.
Git history not consulted (instruction): impossible to date the drift between AGENTS.md, vue.mdc and copilot-instructions.md.
